summary: Full backend + frontend end-to-end testing of Daily OS. 14/14 pytest backend tests pass (auth, daily CRUD, books, learning, monitoring, substack, settings, stats, demo seed/clear, AI summary). Frontend: register/login/session-persist, dashboard with streaks and progress ring, load demo data, AI summary button responds, Daily Entry autosave + persistence after refresh, learning add, book add, monitoring modal renders with charts populated, History calendar renders 30 days and day-detail dialog opens, Substack kanban with all 5 columns and add-article dialog, Journal/Writing/Exercise/Learning/Reviews pages all render, mobile bottom nav + FAB visible at 390px, logout redirects to /login. No blocking issues found.

issues: Uses browser default date picker (input type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar component. Minor consistency issue.
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y warning from Radix). Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to all shadcn DialogContent usages (AddBookDialog, monitoring add, substack add, history day dialog) to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: Consider using shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker for the Monitoring 'Add Monitoring Data' dialog for design consistency (Daily Entry date picker also uses native <input type=date>).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/ai/daily-summary returns raw string coerced from LlmChat response — works but ensure production monitors 502s from provider.
get_current_user tries cookie THEN Bearer in order (fixed and verified) — works.

compute_score streak logic in /api/stats has an edge case: `checked_today` toggles even after first success, which is fine, but the day-0 (today) missing entry still counts as streak break unless learning exists — verified acceptable.
DailyEntry autosave debounce = 900ms, works well; loadedRef guard prevents save on initial load — good.
All endpoints properly exclude Mongo _id via {'_id': 0} projections — good.
test_credentials: tester@dailyos.app / Test1234! (existing, with demo data). Auto-registered fresh TEST_ui_* accounts also work.
seed_data_creation: Used POST /api/demo/seed via Settings 'Load demo data' and via the endpoint directly for tester account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_dailyos_api.py — run: pytest backend/tests/test_dailyos_api.py -v. tester@dailyos.app / Test1234! has demo data. All critical flows verified. Remaining minor items are pure UI polish (DialogDescription, native date picker vs shadcn Calendar).
